en: The image shows a modernist building complex with white and brick facades, featuring sharp lines, geometric forms, and wide steps leading up to the entrance. The sky is bright blue and clear. There is a yellow sign on the ground and some ornamental plants along the steps. No distinct signage or flags are visible.
